设计意图： This mutation adjusts the ATR normalization window from 14 to 20 days to smooth volatility estimates, potentially improving IC and ICIR while preserving the core drawdown-based oversold detection and cross-sectional rank stability. The longer ATR period reduces noise in the volatility denominator, which may enhance linear predictability and consistency of the signal.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

-(close - max(close, 60)) / max(close, 60) / ts_atr(20)
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

-(close - max(close, 60)) / max(close, 60) / ts_atr(20)
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(divide((-subtract(close, ts_max(close, 60))), ts_max(close, 60)), ts_mean((subtract(high, low) maximum (abs(subtract(high, pre_close)) maximum abs(subtract(low, pre_close)))), 20))
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide((-subtract(close, ts_max(close, 60))), ts_max(close, 60))
  3. 3. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(close, ts_max(close, 60))
  4. 4. ts_max —— 过去 N 天滚动最大值
    ts_max(close, 60)
  5. 5. ts_max —— 过去 N 天滚动最大值
    ts_max(close, 60)
  6. 6. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean((subtract(high, low) maximum (abs(subtract(high, pre_close)) maximum abs(subtract(low, pre_close)))), 20)
  7. 7. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(high, low)
  8. 8. abs —— 取绝对值
    abs(subtract(high, pre_close))
  9. 9. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(high, pre_close)
  10. 10. abs —— 取绝对值
    abs(subtract(low, pre_close))
  11. 11. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(low, pre_close)
使用字段：
列含义说明
closeclose（中间变量/衍生量）
highhigh（中间变量/衍生量）
lowlow（中间变量/衍生量）
pre_closepre_close（中间变量/衍生量）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 rolling_max：close.rolling(window=60, min_periods=60).max()
  2. 计算 drawdown：(close - rolling_max) / rolling_max
  3. 计算 high：high.values.astype(float)
  4. 计算 low：low.values.astype(float)
  5. 计算 close：close.values.astype(float)
  6. 计算 atr：pd.Series(talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=20), index=df_copy.index)
  7. 计算 normalized：-drawdown / atr
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

🔍 公式逐行拆解（算子释义）

  1. max(close, 60) — max(x, n) → 滚动最大 / 逐点最大
  2. max(close, 60) — max(x, n) → 滚动最大 / 逐点最大
  3. ATR(20) — talib.ATR(high, low, close, n) → 平均真实波幅

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_drawdown_atr_normalized_20(df): df_copy = df.copy() rolling_max = df_copy["close"].rolling(window=60, min_periods=60).max() drawdown = (df_copy["close"] - rolling_max) / rolling_max high = df_copy["high"].values.astype(float) low = df_copy["low"].values.astype(float) close = df_copy["close"].values.astype(float) atr = pd.Series(talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=20), index=df_copy.index) normalized = -drawdown / atr.replace(0, np.nan) df_copy["factor_drawdown_atr_normalized_20"] = normalized.fillna(0) "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_drawdown_atr_normalized_20"]
